info.title: FigCraft Cloud accounts, history and versions API
info.description: Built-in accounts beside OIDC, attribution and document history. Browser calls use the session cookie and must be same-origin (Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site). Errors use the common envelope {error:{code,message,request_id}}; a refused password adds error.reason='password_policy' and an actionable message.

get.summary: Sign-in methods the workspace offers; bootstrap_required is true only while a single-tenant deployment awaits its first owner; mail_configured says whether the server can send email (false: show copyable links only)

200.description: Sign-in methods the workspace offers; bootstrap_required is true only while a single-tenant deployment awaits its first owner; mail_configured says whether the server can send email (false: show copyable links only)

post.summary: Create a password account from an invitation (link-only invitations need no email: the person chooses login, display name and password; without login an invitation that noted an address uses it) or by open registration; signs the person in. 409 with error.reason 'login_taken' when the login name is in use

201.description: Create a password account from an invitation (link-only invitations need no email: the person chooses login, display name and password; without login an invitation that noted an address uses it) or by open registration; signs the person in. 409 with error.reason 'login_taken' when the login name is in use

post.summary: Complete first-run setup of a single-tenant deployment with a password owner account; signs the owner in

200.description: Complete first-run setup of a single-tenant deployment with a password owner account; signs the owner in

put.summary: Replace the workspace's account settings (at least one method on; open registration needs passwords)

200.description: Replace the workspace's account settings (at least one method on; open registration needs passwords)

post.summary: Sign in with a login and password; every failure is the same 401, repeated failures 429 with Retry-After; passwords disabled for the workspace is 403; rotates the session. must_change_password true means an administrator set the password: the session can only change it (POST /me/password) until then; other routes answer 403 with error.reason 'password_change_required'

200.description: Sign in with a login and password; every failure is the same 401, repeated failures 429 with Retry-After; passwords disabled for the workspace is 403; rotates the session. must_change_password true means an administrator set the password: the session can only change it (POST /me/password) until then; other routes answer 403 with error.reason 'password_change_required'

Give initial_password (typed) or generate_password:true for a temporary password the person must change at first sign-in (a generated one is returned once as generated_password); give neither to receive a one-time setup_token link instead. 409 error.reason 'login_taken'
